newsitem.title: INDIA: Death toll in India police firing rises to three.
newsitem.headline: Death toll in India police firing rises to three.

text.p: Three people have died in police firing to contol a violent mob in a southern Indian town, officials said on Sunday.

Two people were killed on Saturday at Mulbagal, 100 km (62 miles) from Bangalore, capital of the state of Karnataka, after a mob gathered when a rumour began circulating of a religious desecration, which later turned out to be false. A third person died later, officials said.

At least 25 people, six of them were policemen, were injured in the incidents, Karnataka's home (interior) minister Roshan Baig told reporters on Sunday. One of the policemen was in a serious condition, he added.
Baig said the violence in the town, which has a large Moslem population, was not a religious riot but a protest against police's attempts to control a mob.
Police imposed a curfew in the town.
